snippet.title: Charming Hill - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Announcement Trailer for Charming Hill, a sandbox painting game developed by SOPA Games. Players will create hand-crafted landscapes throughout a touching and emotional narrative. Paint gentle prairies, rugged coastlines, stone canyons, and more to become one with the art. Charming Hill is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#CharmingHill #Gaming #IGN
